notes: CASUAL WORKERS TAXED AS THE LAW AND GRA TREAT THEM; REPORTS THAT OPEN TO THEIR TRANSACTIONS; TIGHTER CONTROLS ON CHEQUES, LODGEMENTS AND RECURRING TEMPLATES. A casual worker pays a 5% final withholding on gross (25% non-resident), filed on the withholding return and kept off PAYE. Aged advances, debtors, creditors and commitments, the cheque register, withholding listings and customer statements open each line to its history; ageing is as at today; lines are grouped by person, and an administrator can treat names keyed differently as one person. A cancelled cheque keeps its amount, a receipt's lodgements stay within what it banked, recurring templates can be started afresh, and a posted receipt's reference can be corrected. The Help guide covers all of it. Installing: database changes (0263–0265) that alter no posted figure. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now. Carries everything in 0.6.153.
